_comment: Maps PostgreSQL data types (information_schema.data_type) to BigQuery types.

USER-DEFINED.note: Custom enum types (e.g. film.rating / mpaa_rating) become plain strings.

tsvector.note: Full-text search vectors (film.fulltext) have no BigQuery equivalent. Dropped.

rating.reason: Postgres enum mpaa_rating has no BigQuery equivalent; values (G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17) kept as text.

special_features.reason: Postgres text[] array maps to a BigQuery REPEATED STRING field, preserving each feature as a separate value.

fulltext.reason: tsvector is a Postgres-only search index derived from title/description. BigQuery has its own SEARCH() function, so it is not migrated.
